question: Can you help me calculate the average number of new unicorn companies per year in the top industry from 2019 to 2021?
sql:
-- Calculate average new unicorns per year in Fintech from 2019-2021
-- Total unicorns in Fintech from 2019-2021 divided by 3 years
WITH deduped_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT company_id, date_joined, year_founded 
    FROM companies_dates
),
deduped_industries AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT company_id, industry 
    FROM companies_industries
),
unicorns AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT company_id, valuation 
    FROM companies_funding
    WHERE valuation >= 1000000000
),
joined AS (
    SELECT d.company_id, 
           CAST(SUBSTR(d.date_joined, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as joined_year,
           u.valuation
    FROM deduped_dates d
    JOIN unicorns u ON d.company_id = u.company_id
),
fintech_new AS (
    SELECT di.industry, j.joined_year, COUNT(*) as new_unicorns
    FROM joined j
    JOIN deduped_industries di ON j.company_id = di.company_id
    WHERE j.joined_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
    GROUP BY di.industry, j.joined_year
)
SELECT industry, 
       SUM(new_unicorns) as total_new_unicorns_2019_2021,
       1.0 * SUM(new_unicorns) / 3 as avg_per_year
FROM fintech_new
WHERE industry = 'Fintech'
GROUP BY industry
